subject: Needlemapping: per-1M token benchmark vs hosts — post demo & next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eva Torres <eva.torres@averyhealth.com>, procurement@averyhealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-01-09T15:12:00Z
Subject: Needlemapping: per-1M token benchmark vs hosts — post demo & next steps

Hi Eva — thanks again for the demo today. Quick written recap so we have alignment and clear next steps.

Call highlights (15m):
- Product fit: Avery will use Redwood-hosted inference for clinical note summarization and triage routing. Average request ~60 tokens; expected amplification ~4x on output.
- Volume profile: initial pilot 2–3M tokens/month, scale to 20–30M/month in 6–9 months if latency & accuracy hold. Spikes aligned to business hours (US-Eastern).
- Key constraints: HIPAA-sensitive PII, SOC 2 + audit logs required, data residency in us-east.

Pricing / unit economics discussed:
- You indicated a target unit goal of approximately $700–$900 per 1M tokens (goal price band).
- Quick benchmark ranges (model-dependent, per 1M tokens):
  - OpenAI (recent multi-capability models): ~ $1,200 – $2,300/1M (varies by model & context length)
  - Anthropic (Claude family): ~ $900 – $1,800/1M
  - Open-model hosts (quantized inference offerings we measured): ~ $600 – $1,100/1M depending on quantization and sequence length

Our preliminary position for Avery (volume + compliance needs):
- Intro pilot target price: $900/1M tokens for the pilot (up to 10M total tokens across 3 months), with committed-tier pricing that steps down as you hit monthly bands (20M+ -> target ~$750/1M).
- Why this landing zone: balances Redwood’s managed infra + SOC/compliance overhead vs open-host savings. We can push below $800/1M at higher committed volumes and with a multi-quarter contract.

Attachments: redwood-1m-benchmark.csv (detailed model/host rows), pricing-sheet-avery.pdf (proposed tiered pricing + pilot terms).

Next steps / asks (please):
1) Confirm budget band & procurement timeline (you mentioned a Q1 procurement review).
2) Share the procurement contact or Procurement PO template if you have one.
3) Any required legal/infosec artifacts beyond SOC 2 (e.g., BAAs) — call those out so we can loop Security/Legal.

If that sounds right I’ll circulate a short mutual action plan and a pilot quote for your procurement team.

Thanks — Tessa

--
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
attach: redwood-1m-benchmark.csv (spreadsheet), pricing-sheet-avery.pdf (PDF)

Subject: Re: Needlemapping: per-1M token benchmark vs hosts — post demo & next steps

Thanks Tessa — good summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Budget band: procurement has signaled $700–$900/1M as acceptable for the pilot phase. We can stretch higher for a proof-of-value if we have strong SLA and data residency guarantees.
- Pilot sizing: we want the pilot scoped to ~3 months, expect ~2–4M tokens/month initially.
- Compliance: yes, SOC 2 + BAA. We also need evidence of data isolation and audit logs.

Action items from us:
- I’ve looped procurement. They’ll provide our standard PO template and the initial compliance checklist.
- Procurement contact is procurement@averyhealth.com (same as above). Please include cost breakdowns per 1M tokens and an estimated monthly bill for the pilot.

Appreciate the benchmark CSV — procurement will want the host/model breakout you referenced.

Eva Torres
Dir. Product Ops, Avery Health
